title: Plushiest Grabber

fields.label: Price
fields.value: $75,000 (For the Grabbiest Grabber) & 30.00 USD for the real plush.

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Allows you to pick up even more objects at once for longer, and with a slightly increased range.

body:
"Based upon the REAL LIFE Grabbiest Grabber you can get from Lootbloc! Check them out for all sorts of real life Oaklands merchandise!

 Harnessing the true ultimate power of plushiness... with magic, unicorns, rainbows, and fabric. What a delight!"

Description

The Plushiest Grabber is a tool that was obtained by taking the Grabbiest Grabber and placing it in the middle of Alan's AutoLogistics causing it to turn into the Plushiest Grabber. It emits a faint blue glow when equipped and makes a squeaking noise whenever you use it. It's pick up area also displays as a rounded square rather than the typical circle seen with every other grabber.
